group_level_observations: Coupling to the repo: plugin-creator (all three commands) and vault-keeper are published as installable plugins, but both only work when cwd is the micky-psych-tools root. Their tools (scripts/validate.py, route.py, bump.py) sit outside the plugin directories and are not copied on install. I verified this by installing into a scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: the cache holds only .claude-plugin, commands, skills, README and CHANGELOG. The walk-up vault resolution also matches learn-hub's own .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. A rewrite has two options: ship the scripts inside the plugin via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts, or declare these repo-local project skills (.claude/skills) rather than marketplace plugins.

Validation is split between two tools, and neither is complete. validate.py covers house rules: name == directory, description length 200-1024, version parity, and command/agent description presence. `claude plugin validate --strict` (v2.1.280) covers real YAML parsing, unknown manifest fields, hooks JSON and event names, duplicate plugin names, author presence and a version-drift warning. It passes a stdio MCP server that validate.py rejects. Running the CLI on the marketplace root checks only the manifests (contents: []), so each plugin directory has to be validated separately. All 14 plugins currently pass strict with 0 issues. Neither tool runs evals, finds leftover {{placeholders}}, checks CHANGELOG against version, or checks that cross-plugin and cross-repo references exist.

Description saturation: 10 of 17 skill descriptions in the marketplace are at least 990 characters (cap 1024), totalling about 15,950 characters (about 4k tokens) always in context. The house 200-character floor, plus plugin-creator's 'expand with more trigger phrasings', pushes descriptions toward keyword stuffing and procedural detail. Whether Claude Code's skill-listing character budget truncates this set is unverified and should be checked before the rewrite.

Duplicated information: plugin summaries live on six surfaces (plugin.json, marketplace.json, README.md, the CLAUDE.md Plugins section, MEMORY.md 'Plugins at a glance', ROUTING.md). The measured drift is 9 of 14 plugin.json descriptions differing from the catalog, gridgeist missing from CLAUDE.md, vault-keeper's CHANGELOG two versions behind, and 'Four jobs' against 'Five jobs'. ROUTING.md is about 5k tokens, and all 29 of its Quick-index cues are verbatim substrings of descriptions Claude already has, with every Not-for clause removed.

Mandated context cost per session: CLAUDE.md is about 3.5k tokens (69% plugin list), MEMORY.md is mandated first read at about 27k tokens (108 KB), and ROUTING.md is mandated per request at about 5k tokens.

Evals: the three plugins ship 20 eval cases in total (vault-keeper 6, empty-vault 6, firecrawl 8). All use {skill_name, evals:[{id,name,prompt,expected_output,files:[],assertions:[]}]} with empty assertions, and nothing runs them. plugin-creator and refine-plugin have no evals at all, although the plugin ships an evals template for others.

Undeclared dependencies: the CLI 2.1.280 validator accepts a plugin.json `dependencies` field (no unknown-field warning, while 'bogusField' gets one), yet no plugin declares its real dependencies. Examples are intent-lock and vault-keeper, which about 12 producers rely on. The cross-repo contract (psych vault → learn-hub digest-report, ingest-infographic, ingest-animation) is the most fragile link: learn-hub moved digest-report into plugins/ and added asset receivers on 2026-08-20, and empty-vault (2026-07-13) still looks for .claude/skills/digest-report and deletes assets.

Deterministic logic written as prose that belongs in scripts: vault index rebuild and orphan/reachability report, links-mirror sync, collision suffixing, kebab-topic-to-MOC mapping, CHANGELOG-entry-on-bump, leftover-placeholder checks, and ROUTING freshness. Existing scripts have tooling bugs: the validate.py crash path, route.py writing on `--help`, bump.py's ASCII escaping and missing trailing newline, and the frontmatter parser duplicated between validate.py and route.py.

A vendored guide copied 'verbatim' goes stale: comparing the firecrawl body with the vendor's live SKILL.md (fetched 2026-09-23) found at least 8 material changes, including the build-skills install step, `ask` → `doctor`, the CLI skill rename to `firecrawl`, and keyless REST scope. A rewrite should keep the vendor text as a dated reference, or fetch it at runtime, behind a slim routing body.

Frontmatter portability: plugins/intent-lock/skills/intent-lock/SKILL.md (outside this group) fails PyYAML ('mapping values are not allowed here', line 2 col 574) but passes both validate.py and the CLI. Any rewrite tooling that uses a strict YAML parser will reject it, so quote or fold descriptions consistently.

Side effects of this scan, none in the repo: probes were run on copies and fixtures in the scratchpad, and a scratch CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (scratchpad/cfg) was used for the install check. `git status` in micky-psych-tools is clean.

The digest-report move made the pipeline hub unavailable by default: docs/digest-report-plugin-plan.md:67 says 'Delete `.claude/skills/digest-report/` in the same change' (done; `ls .claude/skills/digest-report` fails), yet always-loaded project skills route to it by name (ingest-infographic SKILL.md:45 'Run **`digest-report`** on the source report', ingest-animation SKILL.md:55), as do the cloned pubmed-research-note SKILL.md:280 and comprehensive-review SKILL.md:172. CLAUDE.md:355 likewise names the pk-plasma-animation plugin as 'the procedure for another molecule'.

Plugins are repo-bound, not portable: none ships a script; every deterministic step calls learn-hub scripts by repo-relative path (scripts/split-note.mjs, voice-qc.mjs, vector-report.mjs, embed-missing.mjs, scripts/animations/pk-plasma/*.mjs, .claude/skills/atomize-book/scripts/measure-depth.py) and reads research-notes/, vault/, .env.local. Packaging them as plugins buys namespacing only, at the price of the install step above. A rewrite must choose one: (a) register the marketplace in project settings (extraKnownMarketplaces with a directory source + enabledPlugins) or (b) move them back to .claude/skills, which always load in this repo.

source-to-vault is a superseded architecture. It was designed 2026-06-24 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-24-source-to-vault-plugin.md, decision #1 'Direct to Supabase — skip markdown-file layer'; its tech stack still names the deprecated project tyxnedapxscpmytanloz). It writes production rows with no /vault file and bypasses the embed, mermaid prebake, image bake, duplication gate, repetition gate, links FK filtering and cache revalidation. Its triggers also collide with pdf-pipeline, atomize-book and ingest-article. It is a deletion candidate, not a rewrite candidate.

The 'atomize' collision from polish-plan P0-2 (docs/plugin-polish-plan.md:70-95) is still open. vault-atomizer triggers on 'atomize the vault' / 'break this chapter into atomic notes' and owns `/atomize`; atomize-book triggers on 'atomize this book'; pubmed-research-note uses 'atomize' as its digest gate word. atomize-book's NOT-for clause still sends 'PubMed/research-cited notes' to pubmed-research-note instead of digest-report. No ROUTING.md or router exists (P2-2).

Report-format contract drift across the report→vault pipeline. The producers (pubmed-research-note SKILL.md:211-224, comprehensive-review SKILL.md:130-138) now forbid inline citations and emit a topic→DOI `## Sources` block. The consumer (digest-report SKILL.md:88-90, 115-116) requires keeping inline author-year+PMID citations and never mentions `## Sources`. pk-plasma-animation's research brief (pubmed-research-plan.md:91) prescribes `<title> (<year>)` Sources lines, which pubmed-research-note SKILL.md:311 lists as a failure. Only the legacy report research-notes/trazodone-novel-and-latest-evidence.md (inline PMIDs) matches digest-report's assumption.

The cross-repo contract with micky-psych-tools vault-keeper/empty-vault is broken on its side. It locates learn-hub as 'the directory containing `.claude/skills/digest-report/`' (empty-vault SKILL.md:36-37), which no longer exists, with a Windows fallback `C:\Users\User\Desktop\Learn` (:39). It deletes rendered HTML assets as non-transferable (:55-57), while learn-hub's ingest-infographic and ingest-animation descriptions expect empty-vault to hand those assets over. It also passes 'notes ... as supplementary source material' (:52-54), and digest-report has no input contract for those.

Operational restatements of CLAUDE.md gotchas have drifted. Several skills re-describe sync mechanics instead of deferring to sync-vault. Examples: digest-report says '~40 min' for a whole-vault re-embed, but sync:apply is incremental (scripts/lib/sync-cache.mjs, apply-sync.mjs:234). digest-report uses PowerShell `Get-CimInstance` in a Linux cloud environment. vault-atomizer says vectors:missing is 'not optional' although apply-sync embeds changed notes (apply-sync.mjs:366-393, 558-559). vault-atomizer runs sync:apply in the foreground while digest-report and pk require a background job with a log. A rewrite should have one owner (sync-vault) and have the others link to it.

Time-sensitive counts are stale everywhere. Measured now: 4,532 `type: note` files (grep -rl '^type: note' vault | wc -l), and `node scripts/split-note.mjs --list` reports '1681 split candidate(s) of 4532 notes' with a worst of 10,943 words (actinf-continuous-time-dynamical-systems). The skills say 2,979 notes / 291 candidates / 7,893 worst (vault-atomizer:9-10), ~2,400 notes / 2,434 present (vault-vectors:82, 137, 152), and ~350 notes missed by the glob (vault-vectors:142).

No quality infrastructure exists. There are no evals in any of the 5 units. The validator proposed in polish-plan P1-1 (scripts/lib/plugin-manifest.mjs + test) does not exist. There is no bump script. The version question P1-2 (docs/plugin-polish-plan.md:140-149) is undecided: the catalog is versionless and all five plugin.json files are pinned at 0.1.0. `claude plugin validate` passes every plugin; the marketplace passes with one warning (no marketplace description).

The MCP config is duplicated. pk-plasma-animation, pubmed-research-note and comprehensive-review each declare identical `pubmed` + `clinical-trials` HTTP servers in .mcp.json. This session also already has the claude.ai PubMed and Clinical_Trials connectors (mcp__PubMed__*, mcp__Clinical_Trials__*), so installing the plugins yields duplicate tool sets under different names.

Cross-group note: .claude/skills/ingest-article/SKILL.md has a single-line description of 1,137 characters, over the 1,024 hard cap (measured with python regex on the frontmatter line). The group reviewing project skills should verify it.

The PDF-reading premise differs between skills. source-to-vault reads PDFs with the Read tool's `pages` rendering (SKILL.md:43-46). pdf-pipeline SKILL.md:60-63 says that rendering needs poppler, which 'usually can't be installed here'. ALWAYS-LOADED CONTEXT: learn-hub/CLAUDE.md is 3,126 lines / 268,390 chars (~67k tokens). Its Gotchas section alone runs lines 817–2997, with 136 top-level gotchas, and 58 of those headings are pipeline/import topics (figures, extraction, sync, order, wikilinks, similarity). That material belongs in the import skills' references, loaded on demand. CLAUDE.md names these skills: sync-vault 13×, atomize-book 8×, ingest-article 6×, verify 4×, ingest-infographic 1×, vault-coverage 1×, the rest 0×.

GOTCHA DRIFT BETWEEN CLAUDE.md AND THE SKILLS. It runs in both directions. (a) CLAUDE.md is newer and the skill is stale: CLAUDE.md:1743 says 'sync:apply is incremental via a content-hash cache', but atomize-book SKILL.md:1116-1117 and 1265-1267 and ingest-article SKILL.md:314-316 still say it re-embeds the whole vault from scratch (~40 min). CLAUDE.md:2588 says body [[topic-id]] is a supported chapter reference and forbids repointing it at a note, but atomize-book SKILL.md:1027-1029 says it 404s and 1063-1067/1248-1256 say to repoint to the order-1 note. CLAUDE.md:2697 calls nested vault folders a trap, yet sync-vault SKILL.md:126-132 recommends that nested layout. (b) The skill is newer and CLAUDE.md is stale: CLAUDE.md:2808 lists four dispositions `mermaid|prose|bake|skip`, while the skills and figure_lib now have six (redraw, chart). CLAUDE.md:2860 says baking uploads to a public bucket, while the skills now use book:file-figures with no upload. (c) Rules CLAUDE.md says belong in the drafting spec are missing from atomize-book: the `\$` money-escaping rule (CLAUDE.md:2489 'belongs in the drafting spec'), the equation-as-PNG EPUB check with its 83%-wrong reconstruction evidence (CLAUDE.md:2511), the stadium-node `([...])` ban, and the LIVE_GROUPS/book-category fixture step (CLAUDE.md:1325 'an import is not finished until its group is in LIVE_GROUPS'). Grep found 0 hits for each in atomize-book/*.md. (d) Duplicated almost verbatim: the number-retention artifact modes, the stale similarity index, bulk-import dedupe filtering, and the split-chapter/MBT story appear both in CLAUDE.md and in atomize-book's body and 'Hard-won traps'.

SHARED SYNC/REVALIDATE/VERIFY TAIL: restated in 8 places (atomize-book §9, ingest-article §7, ingest-slides §7, ingest-infographic §4-5, ingest-animation §4-5, pdf-pipeline §4-6 plus preflight-and-apply.md and surface-checklist.md, sync-vault, check-repetition 'Apply fixes'). The copies give four mutually contradictory apply rules: (1) 'sync.sql ≲200KB → MCP execute_sql, else sync:apply' (sync-vault:32-34, pdf-pipeline:136-141, surface-checklist:13); this can never be met, because pdf-pipeline:150 itself calls the dump 5.8 MB. (2) 'Skip the npm run sync dry run' (ingest-article:313, atomize-book:1116-1122). (3) 'Run all three: sync, sync:apply, revalidate' (ingest-slides:114-118). (4) 'a targeted upsert is equivalent to a full npm run sync' (ingest-infographic:116-118). That last one is wrong, since npm run sync writes only scripts/.out/sync.sql. Revalidation also varies: `npm run revalidate` in most skills, but POST tag 'infographics' (ingest-infographic:131) and a raw POST tag 'notes' (check-repetition:88). The operational sync gotchas live only in CLAUDE.md and partly in atomize-book, not in sync-vault, which is the skill that actually runs the sync: background job + log, no `| tail`, check EXIT=0 plus the Upserted line, no `&` inside run_in_background, the TaskStop zombie, git fetch before syncing, and the 'session-start: ready' / PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH preconditions.

ROUTING OVERLAP between pdf-pipeline, ingest-article, ingest-slides and atomize-book. pdf-pipeline is the declared front door for any PDF. It routes article→ingest-article, book→atomize-book, and report/extract→'atomize-book (mini)'. It explicitly sends SLIDE DECKS to atomize-book mini (SKILL.md:98; routing.md:42,60) and never mentions ingest-slides, which claims slide decks→ARTICLES. So two skills give opposite answers for the same input. ingest-article triggers on any 'drops a PDF and says ingest this article', and on a bare invocation it sweeps an inbox. pdf-pipeline triggers on 'ingest this PDF' and 'turn this PDF into notes'. atomize-book triggers on '.epub/.pdf in Book/', and also on 're-sync the vault', which is sync-vault's trigger.
